description: The closest distance between two objects in space over a period (default 1 day, at most 7): when, how close (timed to a fraction of a second) and, for two Earth satellites, how fast they pass each other. For education only: public orbits are not precise enough for collision avoidance, and the answer says so.

days.description: Length of the search in days (default 1).

lang.description: Language of names and texts (default en).

time_zone.description: IANA time zone for local times, e.g. "Europe/Paris".

name: perigee_close_approach
title: Closest approach in space
